headline_notes: Director at Alhambra Infrastructure Advisors (Dubai) since October 2023, a boutique strategy consultancy covering aviation, ports and maritime, railways, roads and urban mobility, and logistics and supply chains across Europe, the Middle East and Africa. Around 12 to 15 years in transport and infrastructure strategy: previously Principal, Senior Manager and Manager at ALG (Dubai, 2019 to 2023) and analyst at CETMO, the transport-studies centre for the Western Mediterranean, in Barcelona. MSc in Civil Engineering from the Universitat Politècnica de Catalunya, with an exchange at the University of Liège. Alhambra's April 2026 insight on the Gulf conflict and Middle East air-passenger markets signals the firm's live exposure to Strait of Hormuz and Red Sea disruption. Sources: alhambraadvisors.com (about-us, sectors, insights), LinkedIn (in/genisgarciaalzorriz).
